name: AgentRecBench
description: AgentRecBench is the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM agent-based personalized recommender systems. It includes an interactive textual recommendation simulator with rich user/item metadata and three evaluation scenarios (classic, evolving-interest, cold-start), a modular framework for agentic recommender development, and a leaderboard for ongoing community evaluation.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with early community interest, but it is not yet widely established as a standard recommender-system evaluation suite.
notes: Includes an interactive simulator and three recommendation scenarios; benchmark validated via open challenge and maintained leaderboard.
